title: HDFC Bank has a history of compliance issues. Here’s a list - The HinduBusinessLine
summary: HDFC Bank faced governance concerns due to the abrupt resignation of its non-executive chairman over ethics and values differences. The bank also had several compliance issues in recent years, including fines for benchmarking issues, outsourcing know-your-customer compliance, violations of deposit rate rules, and persistent IT outages affecting credit card issuance.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights negative aspects such as the resignation of a key figure due to governance issues and multiple fines and restrictions due to compliance failures, indicating a negative market impact.
